Replays tested on OMP

No replay has run on OMP. All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about OMP.

What the OMP setup page says about coverage

Wrap gates the commands you route through it. OMP invocations made any other way (an interactive session, an unwrapped script) never touch KYA. Coverage is exactly the set of invocations you wrap, no more.

Source: the OMP recipe.

Install

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
